scenario: Greeting someone for the first time
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello! My name is Ana.
dialogue.translation: Salama! Maqaa keessan Ana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hi, Ana. Nice to meet you. I am Carlos.
dialogue.translation: Salama, Ana. Dhiheessi dhufte. Ana Carlos.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you too. This is my friend, Luis.
dialogue.translation: Dhiheessi keessis dhufte. Kuni keessan shaggan keessan, Luis.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: Hello, Luis. I am from Spain.
dialogue.translation: Salama, Luis. Ana guddaa Espaanii keessaa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: And I am from Mexico. Welcome!
dialogue.translation: Fi ana guddaa Mekisiko keessaa. Akkan deebii!

scenario: Asking where something is in a store
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, where is the bread?
dialogue.translation: Haqa keessan, saamii kan biratti deebii?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It is over there, on that shelf.
dialogue.translation: Kan arratti deebii, seenaa kanarratti.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is it right there?
dialogue.translation: Kan itti malee deebii?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes. You need to get it from the top.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee. Kan hojii keessaa qabdu dandeessu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you!
dialogue.translation: Galatoomi!

scenario: Ordering a drink at a café
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Kan biraa hin dhaga'u akkas jedhu: 'Can I have...?'
Kan biraa mana hin dhiphina ‘haa’ jedhu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What can I get for you?
dialogue.translation: Ma qabaa kennu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Can I have a coffee, please?
dialogue.translation: Bunni qaba dhihaa fadhii ta’ee?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hot or cold?
dialogue.translation: Gummate yoo hufante?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hot, please. And what tea do you have?
dialogue.translation: Gummate, fadhii ta’ee. Ma shaii haa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Here you go. Your coffee and tea.
dialogue.translation: Kan deema. Bunnin keessan shaiin keessan.

key_phrases.phrase: What can I get for you?

scenario: Buying a ticket at a station
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: ‘One ticket’ jechuudhaan akka ta’ee itti dhufuu argama.
Haala dhaabbataa kana malee itti du’aa.
Hanga amantii kana biraa hin jiruuf du’aa.
Malee waan tokko akkasumas walitti dhuunfaa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want one ticket to London, please.
dialogue.translation: Tikii tokko Londonitti jaalata dhufaa, fadii.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: For today, with the train now?
dialogue.translation: Guyyaa, malee qorraa waan tokko?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but very early, and then I go to work.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee, garuu sirrii bishaan, akkasumas walitti dhuunfaa mana ba’ee keessatti.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: OK, you have the train at six. That is good.
dialogue.translation: Miidhagaa, qorraa guyyaa lallattoonniitti jira. Kana malee waan miidhagaa.

scenario: Checking in at a hotel reception
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Kanatti uumama kana hin jiruuf jecha godhaa keessatti argama.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good evening. Do you have a reservation?
dialogue.translation: Guyyaa waraana. Kanatti uumama kana hin jirtu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we have a room for two nights.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee, nuti mana dhaabbata guyyaa lamaaniif kanne.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Here is your key. Your room is on the third floor.
dialogue.translation: Kana keessu macasu. Manne keessu gurguddaa sadan irra jira.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thank you. We need help with our bags.
dialogue.translation: Galatoomi. Nuti caqasuu dhaabbatu keessumaa jiraachu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Of course. How long do you want to stay?
dialogue.translation: Kanarrissumma. Guyyaa waraana ta’uu deebi’u godhaa?

key_phrases.phrase: How long do you want to stay?

scenario: Meeting a new neighbor
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Kana keessa jiraataa ta’ee malee barbaachisa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi! I see you just moved into the house next door.
dialogue.translation: Halawaa! Kana barbaachisaa mana keessan dhufne.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I live here now. It is my new home.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee, kana keessanii jiraachuu dhiisee. Mana baruu keessan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That is great! So, do you need help with your things today?
dialogue.translation: Kan biraa! Haa ta’u, guyyaa kana keessaa ta’u barbaachisaa keessan irraa dhuma’aa barbaadhu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe later. Oh, the door is open. Let me close it.
dialogue.translation: Yeroo kan biraa. Ayyaanaa, dookaan te’ee. Kana guutumaa godha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No problem. I am at home all morning. Come by any time.
dialogue.translation: Haalummaa hin jiru. Mana keessan guyyaa harkaa hundaa. Yeroo kan danda’u godha.

scenario: Asking the time on the street
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Kan mannaa wakaa deebisu akkas jedhama: 'What time is it?'
Kan mannaan 'Do you have the time?' = Waka keessan kan hin jiru?
Kan 'Can you tell me...' = Haa ta'u malee jechu dandeessu?
Kan bira hin taane akkas jechuu wajjin: 'I don't know.'
Kan murteessuun ykn waka godhaa ta'e akkas jechuu wajjin.
Kan 'see you then' = Guyyaa kanarraa beeka'u.
Kan wakaa ta'e akkas jechuu wajjin: 'at three' = Saddi irra.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, do you have the time?
dialogue.translation: Haqa maqaa, waka keessan kan hin jiru?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sorry, I don't know. I don't have a watch.
dialogue.translation: Maaf, haqa hin taane. Sa'aa keessan kan hin jiru.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, but can you tell me if it's late?
dialogue.translation: Nyalaa, haata'u malee murteessuun ta'u dandeessu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think it's about three now.
dialogue.translation: Saddi gaddisi yanzam taanaan jechuu dhorgu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you! See you at three then.
dialogue.translation: Galatoomi! Guyyaa kanarraa saddi irra beeka'u.

scenario: At the doctor for a basic checkup
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Kana malee keessan haasa’aa tokko duubatti kennu hubachuudha.
Qabxii lamaansaan fi lamaan danda’uudhaan irra deebi’u hubachuudha.
Qabxii lamaan danda’uudhaan irra deebi’u hubachuudha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How do you feel today?
dialogue.translation: Guyyaa kana malee haasa’aa tokko duubatti kennu hubataa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Not better than yesterday. I have some pain here.
dialogue.translation: Guyyaa duubatti dheeraa hin hubanu. Haasa’aa tokko duubatti kennu miti.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: You should take this medicine. All is fine, but rest more.
dialogue.translation: Dawaa kana keessatti kabachi qaba. Hunda si hin jiru, garuu dheeraa hinka’i.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: How much do I take each day?
dialogue.translation: Guyyaa tokkoon dheeraa kabachi qaba’a?

scenario: Paying at a supermarket checkout
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That is the total. The price is twenty dollars.
dialogue.translation: Kana guddaa. Qimaasaa doolaar lamaani.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: OK. How much does it cost? Can I pay with a card?
dialogue.translation: Adabii. Qimaa kan qabda? Kardii keessatti kubaa danda’u?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, here is the card machine. And here is your receipt.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee, kanas machinii kardii. Kana biraas.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thank you. I am out of cash, so card is good.
dialogue.translation: Galaata. Maaliin kan hin jiru, haa ta’ee kardii adabii.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Here is your change. Have a nice day!
dialogue.translation: Kana kubsaas. Guyyaa adabii irra deebii!

scenario: Calling a friend to make simple plans
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Telefoonnitti haasa’aa fi barumsaa malee isaanii wajjin tokko dhufeera.
Qorophii tokko ilaalcha dhuunfa hin jiru malee isaanii wajjin tokko dhufeera.
Barumsaa fi hin qabanaa malee isaanii wajjin tokko dhufeera.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi, this is me. Can you call me today?
dialogue.translation: Taan, kan nan. Guyyaa nan duubaa danda'a?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I can call you now. Where are you?
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee, guyyaa keessan duubaa qaba. Guyyaa ta'e?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I am at home. Can you see me tomorrow?
dialogue.translation: Mana dhiiseessu dubbii. Bako nan beeka danda'a?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I can see you tomorrow. Where do we meet?
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee, bako si beeka qaba. Guyyaa haa baraa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Meet me on this street, near the park.
dialogue.translation: Kan gabaa biraa keessummaa nan baraa.

scenario: Describing your family to someone
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Mana barumsa yookiin hojiiwwan godhaa keessatti argama.
‘‘Eeyaa’’ kan ta’ee itti fayyadamaa malee isaanii akkas jedhan.
‘‘Abaa’’ kan ta’ee itti fayyadamaa malee isaanii akkas jedhan.
Intalaa kan ta’ee, isa godhatee yookiin isa godhatee kan ta’ee isaanii akkas jedhan.
Shagraa kan ta’ee, isa godhatee yookiin isa godhatee kan ta’ee isaanii akkas jedhan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tell me about your family.
dialogue.translation: Hojii keessanitti haasa’u malee.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I live with my mother, father, and two sisters. My brother is not at home.
dialogue.translation: Haadhaa fi abbaa hanga isa intalaa lamaan hojjennee jira. Shagraa kanas isa mana jiraachuu hin dandeessan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is your father old or young?
dialogue.translation: Abbaa kee gaddisa yookiin dhihaa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: He is not very old, but my mother is very young.
dialogue.translation: Isaan gaddisa dhibaa hin jiru malee, haadhaa kanas dhihaa dhibaa ta’ee jira.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And your sisters? Are they young too?
dialogue.translation: Cana intalaa keessan? Isaanis dhihaa ta’een jiru?

key_phrases.phrase: live with my mother and father

scenario: Asking for directions in the street
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is the station far from here?
dialogue.translation: Haqaaniin, baaburaa kan du’aa gara kaanatti?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it's near. Go straight and turn left at the next street.
dialogue.translation: Ayyaanaa, du’aa keessatti jira. Hojii deebi’i kennuuf dhiheessaa guyyaa lama keessatti kennu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Go straight and turn left? Is that right?
dialogue.translation: Hojii deebi’i kennuuf dhiheessaa kennu? Kana dhihaa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that's right. Then go straight again. The station is on your right.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyam, kana dhihaa. Akakaa hojii deebi’i kennu. Baaburaa dhihaa keessatti jira.

scenario: On a bus asking the driver for help
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Mana busiin galmaa qabda kennu akkas jedhama.
Kanarratti, 'get off' jechaa deebisu akkas jedhama.
'Get off' jechuun phrasal verb irra deebisu akkas jedhama.
Hundarra qaban yaada godhu akkas jedhama.
Hundummaa irra hinjirtu godhu akkas jedhama.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, can you help me? I need to get off at the next stop.
dialogue.translation: Fadhii, caqasuu danda'a? Galmaa duraatti deebisu barbaada.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. Which stop do you want? This is the next stop.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee. Galmaa warri barbaaddaa? Kuni galmaa dura ta'ee jira.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want the stop near the hospital. How many stops from here?
dialogue.translation: Galmaa sirnaa dhaabbataa barbaada. Galmaan kan qabduwwan warri jiraatan?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's three stops down. Please sit down, I will tell you.
dialogue.translation: Galmaan sadan hojiiru jira. Fadhii, seeti, ta'u malee galaa.

key_phrases.phrase: get off at the next stop

scenario: Introducing a colleague at work
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Barreeffamee kana malee qajeelaa hojii irra jiruuf kennu malee hojii irra dhufu.
Barreeffamee kana malee qajeelaa hojii irra jiruuf kennu malee hojii irra dhufu.
Kanarraa malee qajeelaa hojii irra jiruuf kennu malee hojii irra dhufu.
Barreeffamee kana malee qajeelaa hojii irra jiruuf kennu malee hojii irra dhufu.
Barreeffamee kana malee qajeelaa hojii irra jiruuf kennu malee hojii irra dhufu.

dialogue.speaker: C

scenario: Leaving a voicemail message
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, this is Ana. Please leave a message after the beep.
dialogue.translation: Taan Anaa. Maaliif galchi fuyyuu qorree guyyaa kennin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Hi Ana, this is Luis. Please call me back soon.
dialogue.translation: Taan Luis. Maaliif dubbifachuu dhiheessan.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, Luis. What is your number?
dialogue.translation: Miidhaga, Luis. Lammi keessan qalma?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It is 555-1234. Thank you!
dialogue.translation: 555-1234. Galatoomi!

scenario: At the post office sending a package
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Yeroo kan, ‘have’ jira achi hojjetti qabxii baay’ee

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want to send this package to my friend.
dialogue.translation: Baqala kan gara sa’ii keessani deebi’u godha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We have it at the counter. Please fill out this form for the package.
dialogue.translation: Kan gara qabxii keessani jira. Adda adda, foormii kan gara baqalaa haa bara.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is this all for the package?
dialogue.translation: Kan hunda gara baqalaa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we have all we need. You can send it now.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee, nuti hunda jiran. Kan deebi’u dandeessa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you.
dialogue.translation: Galatoomi kee.

scenario: Describing your daily routine
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I get up at seven in the morning.
dialogue.translation: Saakuu guyyaa 7:00 da guttee.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Then I have breakfast and go to work.
dialogue.translation: Kanarra duk’aa utuu qilleensaa teesse.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I work at home in the evening.
dialogue.translation: Galchiinsa mana keessatti qillee.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I watch TV because I like it.
dialogue.translation: Teelefiishinii beegnu kunis haa ta’ee.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Then I sleep at ten.
dialogue.translation: Guyyaa 10:00 da nuufte.

scenario: Asking about opening hours
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Kanaa tokko qabdu kan biraa isaanii jiraa barbaachisuuf godhaa.
Haala dhaabachuu ykn qabsoo godhu keessaa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Can you tell me the open time today?
dialogue.translation: Guyyaa kana sa’aa fekkatti dubbifachaa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We open at nine, but we close at five.
dialogue.translation: Sa’aa sagaalaa fekkannu, garuu sa’aa murtii dhufnnu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And on Saturday, until what time are you open?
dialogue.translation: Akakaatti, sanbata guyyaa akakaatti sa’aa fekkatti?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: On Saturday, we close at one.
dialogue.translation: Sanbata guyyaa, sa’aa tokkoo dhufnnu.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.translation: Maqaa keessan isa baaseen dubbii akkasuma baaseen biraa godha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The fish is very good here.

dialogue.speaker: B

key_phrases.translation: Maqaa keessan irraa jiruuf godhaa ta’eera?

scenario: At the bank for a simple transaction
frequency_note: top 300 most frequent words of English

vocabulary.note: Afaan Ingiliffii keessatti qooda jiraa ta'ee: 'money' muluma kana malee hinqabne.
Qooda (‘more money’) kana dhaabbata (‘more quickly’) malee ta’u danda’u.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I need money now.
dialogue.translation: Yani dubarti hojjadhu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Here is your card. Go there with your ID.
dialogue.translation: Kan kootiin keessaniiti. Jijjiiruu hanga galmaa keessaniitti deebi’i.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Will you give me more cash?
dialogue.translation: Himi haa malii cubsuu hin dandeessu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I will give you the money now. Go there.
dialogue.translation: Eeyyee, yani dubarti cubsuu maqaa. Jijjiiruu deebi’i.
